name: Sierra no Bouken, Hametsu no Doukutsu
original_name: シエラの冒険、破滅の洞窟
source:
A story where there is no rescue.

A rookie scout from the adventurer's guild goes on her first solo adventure and accidentally triggers an out-of-the-way trap in the beginner dungeon. After falling through a trap hole, she finds herself in an unreported labyrinth filled with corpses bearing a variety of mysterious wounds. There is no sign of any adventurer having ever escaped, yet our heroine seeks a way out.
translation:
一个无人救援的故事。

冒险者公会的一名新手斥候，第一次独自出外冒险时，不慎触发了初级地下城偏僻处的一道机关。跌入陷阱后，她发现自己身处一座从未有人报告过的迷宫，四处都是带着各种诡异伤口的尸体。没有任何迹象表明曾有冒险者逃出生天，但女主人公依然在寻找出路。
